question.prompt: In parallelogram \(ABCD\), \(AB=x+2\) and \(AD=2x-3\) (unit: cm). If parallelogram \(ABCD\) is a rhombus, find its side length. (Unit: cm.)

solutions.explanation: Adjacent sides of a rhombus are equal, so \(x+2=2x-3\), giving \(x=5\). The side length is \(5+2=7\).
solutions.title: Equate the rhombus sides
